title: Local outlier factor (LOF)
description: The local outlier factor (LOF) algorithm computes a score indicating the degree of abnormality of each input observation.

dataset.title: Dataset
dataset.description: GeoJSON dataset of points in one CRS for which LOF scores should be computed.

n_neighbors.title: Number of neighbors
n_neighbors.description: Number of neighbors to use for neighbor queries.

leaf_size.title: Leaf size
leaf_size.description: Leaf size passed to the spatial tree.

output_column.title: Output column name
output_column.description: Name of the column in which to store the output metric.

output_dataset.title: Output Dataset
output_dataset.description: The input dataset with the computed LOF metric.
